data.content_ref: inline:The target's stated refutation condition only addresses the two extremes of sufficiency (a single layer alone suffices) and joint inconsistency. But this leaves an intermediate failure mode unhandled that the integration itself presupposes: the layers may be jointly consistent and no single layer individually sufficient, yet still unable to jointly constitute verification because the ordering by ascending inferential strength is the wrong dependency relation. The target says a run failing SRC_002 cannot be validated by SRC_003 or SRC_005, but it never establishes that execution-trace detection is a prerequisite for cross-run bias detection or decorrelation — the layers are described as detecting orthogonal failure modes (within-run restatement vs. across-run bias vs. principled unification), and the 'refuted if' clause provides no condition under which the specific blocking order is shown to be the wrong relation while still preserving consistency, so the integration relation is under-specified against a real gap.
